lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information contributions and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset includes approximately 609,000 buildings with metadata on data age and recent update frequency, representing an estimated 42% of total building coverage in Mauritania based on AI-assisted mapping validation.
